title: Missing Ghoul Bookkeeper
summary: A ghoul who tracked petty boons, feeding favors, and minor debts has disappeared with an annotated ledger.
use: Use for local leverage, blackmail, or to expose small lies that point toward a larger conspiracy.

title: Restless Herd Cell
summary: A dependable herd circle has begun acting strangely after someone new started screening access and conversations.
use: Use for social suspicion, feeding instability, or a subtle enemy move against the character's support base.

title: Boon Called Too Early
summary: A minor boon is invoked at the worst possible moment, forcing the character to choose between pride, safety, and reputation.
use: Use to pressure etiquette, status, and competing priorities during a larger scene.

title: Street Predator Copycat
summary: A mortal or thin-blood is imitating a known predator's feeding pattern badly enough to attract attention.
use: Use to create Masquerade risk, false blame, or a messy chance to gain leverage over vulnerable actors.
